items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: I run into a fella out there. Some of the best piano players I'd ever heard. The man out there now, if he's still alive, by the name of Harvey Brooks.

ctx.x: What about Los Angeles? They had many piano players out there? Yeah, I found some nice musicians out there.
Look a fella out there. I run into a fella out there. Some of the best piano players I'd ever heard. The man out there now, if he's still alive, by the name of Harvey Brooks.
Oh yeah, he's still going. Yeah, you know, did you have him? Sure, he was making records with Joe Dierensburg. Oh. You know that Yellow Dog Blues that was a hit? Yeah. That was him on piano, then.
